ChernarusMap.descriptionShort: Folded tourist map. Displays topography, marked tourist trails, useful points of interest and significant landmarks.

Compass.author: dayz
Compass.descriptionShort: A classic compass. Helps with orientation, provided you know how to use it properly.

OrienteeringCompass.author: dayz
OrienteeringCompass.descriptionShort: Used for hiking, its needle points to the north, helping with orientation. It is very difficult to get lost with one of these.

GPSReceiver.author: dayz
GPSReceiver.descriptionShort: A sophisticated device that can receive a signal from the global positioning system, triangulate user's position, and calculate their altitude. Requires a battery to operate.

PersonalRadio.author: dayz
PersonalRadio.descriptionShort: Medium range, two-way personal radio with a frequency switch. Requires a battery to operate.

BaseRadio.author: dayz
BaseRadio.descriptionShort: A R-105 portable base radio station operating on wide set of frequencies on long ranges. Can also be hooked to a vehicle battery.

Megaphone.author: dayz
Megaphone.descriptionShort: A megaphone used to make announcements or indiscreetly communicate over large distances. Requires a battery to operate.

Radio.author: dayz
Radio.descriptionShort: $UNT$A device, such as a walkie-talkie, that transmits or receives such signals.

AlarmClock_Green.descriptionShort: Common table alarm clock. Spring powered and apparently still working.

Flashlight.descriptionShort: A battery-powered flashlight. Functional enough to provide more than a narrow cone of light.

Pen_Black.descriptionShort: Regular colored pen. Unsurprisingly, can be used for writing and marking things down.

CanOpener.author: dayz
CanOpener.descriptionShort: This common household instrument is used to smoothly open metal/tin cans, with no content spilling.

Heatpack.author: dayz
Heatpack.descriptionShort: Small disposable heat source, keeps you warm for a limited time when put into a jacket, pants or vest.

MessTin.author: dayz
MessTin.descriptionShort: $UNT$Made from aluminium, designed to be used with a portable cooking apparatus. Conviently contains a skillet, a kettle, a plate, a cup and a set of cutlery.

Pliers.author: dayz
Pliers.descriptionShort: Metal tool with head resembling jaws. Definitely useful for wire cutting and some light bending.

Lockpick.author: dayz
Lockpick.descriptionShort: Universal lock pick. Very handy, if you need to unlock something somebody else wanted to keep locked.

WeaponCleaningKit.author: dayz
WeaponCleaningKit.descriptionShort: A wooden box, containing complete and universal gun-care system. Used in firearm maintenance.

SewingKit.author: dayz
SewingKit.descriptionShort: A pocket-sized universal sewing kit, comes in handy for patching both clothes and people's wounds.

LeatherSewingKit.author: dayz
LeatherSewingKit.descriptionShort: An universal leather sewing kit used for stitching leather together, or patching various items made from it.

Handcuffs.author: dayz
Handcuffs.descriptionShort: Steel handcuffs, useful for handcuffing your friends and foes. As they can be locked easily, having keys to unlock them is recommended.

HandcuffKeys.author: dayz
HandcuffKeys.descriptionShort: Small metal keys for opening handcuffs. Losing them makes opening handcuffs a hassle.

ScientificBriefcaseKeys.author: dayz
ScientificBriefcaseKeys.descriptionShort: Metal key with a colored plastic cover.

ShippingContainerKeys_Blue.author: dayz
ShippingContainerKeys_Blue.descriptionShort: Container key with a round bit made out of metal.

ShippingContainerKeys_Orange.author: dayz
ShippingContainerKeys_Orange.descriptionShort: Container key with a round bit made out of metal.

ShippingContainerKeys_Yellow.author: dayz
ShippingContainerKeys_Yellow.descriptionShort: Container key with a round bit made out of metal.

ShippingContainerKeys_Red.author: dayz
ShippingContainerKeys_Red.descriptionShort: Container key with a round bit made out of metal.

Cassette.author: dayz
Cassette.descriptionShort: $UNT$Old classic cassette used for recording of music or voice.

Shovel.author: dayz
Shovel.descriptionShort: Ordinary shovel. Strong, steel blade easily splits both soil and skulls.

FieldShovel.author: dayz
FieldShovel.descriptionShort: A shovel most often used by soldiers as well as adventurers and survivalists. It's usually used as a tool to dig trenches and build camping grounds, but it also makes for a good self-defense weapon.

Crowbar.author: dayz
Crowbar.descriptionShort: Standard curved crowbar. Read instructions before use. May cause injuries if handled improperly.

FireExtinguisher.author: dayz
FireExtinguisher.descriptionShort: $UNT$The instructions read: 1. Hold upright. Pull ring pin. 2. Start back 10 feet. Aim at base of fire. 3. Squeeze lever. 4. Sweep side to side. Dry chemical powder type.

Hammer.author: dayz
Hammer.descriptionShort: A multi-purpose tool. Mostly thanks to the fact, that, after a while, everything tends to look like a nail.

MeatTenderizer.author: dayz
MeatTenderizer.descriptionShort: Tool used to tenderize slabs of meat in preparation for cooking. Although the head is heavy and resistant, the handle may not stand up to excessive force.

Wrench.author: dayz
Wrench.descriptionShort: Adjustable metal wrench made for dealing with fasteners. Small enough to be used in tight space.

LugWrench.author: dayz
LugWrench.descriptionShort: Heavy blunt implement. Also an useful tool for getting wheels off the car for maintenance.

Pipe.author: dayz
Pipe.descriptionShort: A lead pipe used in plumbing to deliver water where needed. Has been taken out of a piping system to be used as a weapon of personal destruction.

Screwdriver.author: dayz
Screwdriver.descriptionShort: Regular screwdriver. Can be gently inserted into a screw, or into somebody's jugular.

Sickle.author: dayz
Sickle.descriptionShort: A hand-held agricultural tool with a curved blade. Typically used for harvesting grain crops or cutting succulent forage.

Hacksaw.author: dayz
Hacksaw.descriptionShort: Invaluable crafting tool, intended to saw off metal pipes. It has other uses as well.

KitchenKnife.author: dayz
KitchenKnife.descriptionShort: A sharp kitchen knife with broad blade and a sturdy handle. Can handle vegetable as well as meat.

SteakKnife.author: dayz
SteakKnife.descriptionShort: A sharp table knife, used for cutting steak. Serrated blade cuts any meat with ease.

HayHook.author: dayz
HayHook.descriptionShort: $UNT$A hand tool is used for securing and moving hay stacks. It consists of a round wooden handle with a strong metal hook projecting at a right angle from the center of the handle. The appliance is held in a closed fist with the hook projecting between two fingers. Can be also used as a weapon inflicting stab and cut wounds.

StoneKnife.author: dayz
StoneKnife.descriptionShort: A shard of stone. Not very durable or sharp, but useful, if you have nothing else at hand.

BoneKnife.author: dayz
BoneKnife.descriptionShort: Once sharpened, this bone has revealed itself to be a decent knife.

Mace.author: dayz
Mace.descriptionShort: Replica of a mace with a long, sturdy handle, and a steel head. It can be used to dish out heavy hits and cause some serious trauma.

FarmingHoe.author: dayz
FarmingHoe.descriptionShort: A farming hoe also known as the Dutch hoe. A sharp piece of metal at the end of a wooden rod. Designed to cultivate soil or penetrate any fragile or soft object.

ImprovisedFishingRod.author: dayz
ImprovisedFishingRod.descriptionShort: A piece of rope tied to a stick. This marvelous invention can be surprisingly useful, provided some bait is available.

ObsoleteFishingRod.author: dayz
ObsoleteFishingRod.descriptionShort: $UNT$Old but still highly functional long, flexible length of carbon fiber composite used to catch fish.

FishingRod.author: dayz
FishingRod.descriptionShort: An extendable fishing rod. Highly portable, it makes fishing seem simple, provided some bait is available.

SledgeHammer.author: dayz
SledgeHammer.descriptionShort: Flat metal head can apply more force than other hammers, due to its large size. Certainly useful for various demolition purposes.

Iceaxe.author: dayz
Iceaxe.descriptionShort: Used by climbers, this multi-purpose equipment can serve both as a tool and a weapon.

Broom.author: dayz
Broom.descriptionShort: A cleaning tool consisting of stiff fibers attached to a stick. Mostly used to clean floors, also useful for getting rid of spider webs and to scare animals away.

Broom_Birch.author: dayz
Broom_Birch.descriptionShort: Handmade sweeping utensil. The design is old, but still effective to scare children.

Paddle.author: dayz
Paddle.descriptionShort: $UNT$A tool used for pushing against liquids, either as a form of propulsion in a boat or as an implement for mixing. Paddles commonly used in canoes consist of a wooden rod (the shaft) with a handle on one end and a rigid sheet (the blade) on the other end. This old canoe paddle seems like it has been left to rot for some time.

ElectronicRepairKit.author: dayz
ElectronicRepairKit.descriptionShort: This soft case contains an array of tools for electronics repair and maintenance. Also has several attached diagrams.

EpoxyPutty.author: dayz
EpoxyPutty.descriptionShort: A stick of hand-mixable reinforced epoxy putty. Allows for quick and easy repairing of hard surfaces.

Whetstone.author: dayz
Whetstone.descriptionShort: This whetstone can be used to sharpen edges of various bladed weapons and tools.

HandSaw.author: dayz
HandSaw.descriptionShort: A handy carpenter tool designed to saw through wood. Useful for construction or woodworking.

FireworksLauncher.author: dayz
FireworksLauncher.descriptionShort: Box full of fireworks, ready to light any party up. It's probably still good, even if mildly damaged or damp. Do not ignite while indoors and stay away from it after ignition.

Anniversary_FireworksLauncher.author: dayz
Anniversary_FireworksLauncher.descriptionShort: Box full of fireworks, ready to light any party up. It's probably still good, even if mildly damaged or damp. Do not ignite while indoors and stay away from it after ignition.

RemoteDetonator.author: dayz
RemoteDetonator.descriptionShort: A set consisting of detonator and receiver. Meant to arm explosives and trigger their detonation from a safe distance.

RemoteDetonatorReceiver.author: dayz
RemoteDetonatorReceiver.descriptionShort: A device to trigger blasting caps from a safe distance. Apparently, the LEDs turn on when the detonator and receiver are both armed and in range.

RemoteDetonatorTrigger.author: dayz
RemoteDetonatorTrigger.descriptionShort: A device to trigger blasting caps from a safe distance. Apparently, the LEDs turn on when the detonator and receiver are both armed and in range.

Blowtorch.author: dayz
Blowtorch.descriptionShort: Metalworking tool; primarily used to cut and weld metal. It's designed to be fed by gas canisters.

BearTrap.author: dayz
BearTrap.descriptionShort: Old-fashioned but functional, this marvel of mechanical engineering can almost snap your leg in half.

LandMineTrap.author: dayz
LandMineTrap.descriptionShort: Anti-personnel mine. Provides a nasty surprise for anybody unlucky enough to step on it.

SmallFishTrap.author: dayz
SmallFishTrap.descriptionShort: The neck of the bottle has been cut off, inverted, and then placed back in. This makeshift funnel device will trap anything unlucky enough to get lured in by a piece of bait placed inside.

FishNetTrap.author: dayz
FishNetTrap.descriptionShort: A fish trap made from netting with a metal wire structure. Bait is used to lure fish inside, and once they get in, they're unlikely to find their way out again.

TripwireTrap.author: dayz
TripwireTrap.descriptionShort: A passive mechanism. Designed to trigger a device when the wire is pulled.

RabbitSnareTrap.author: dayz
RabbitSnareTrap.descriptionShort: A simple yet smart trap. Through the use of different baits, you can effectively attract a variety of small animals.

WoodAxe.author: dayz
WoodAxe.descriptionShort: Useful for splitting wood or other objects, including closed cans and an occasional forehead.

Hatchet.author: dayz
Hatchet.descriptionShort: Single-handed bladed tool with a hammer head on one side. Except for chopping wood, it has a wide array of uses.

FirefighterAxe.author: dayz
FirefighterAxe.descriptionShort: Firefighter axe is used primarily for breaking down doors and windows. Can be also used for wood cutting or other mundane activities.

Cleaver.author: dayz
Cleaver.descriptionShort: A big, heavy, sharp knife. Designed to slash through thick raw meat. It can also crack bones easily. Mostly used by butchers.

CombatKnife.author: dayz
CombatKnife.descriptionShort: Sharp combat knife with a sturdy blade and a handle. Great for self-defense, but it has other, more mundane uses as well.

HuntingKnife.author: dayz
HuntingKnife.descriptionShort: This hunting knife is used during hunting to skin animals and cut up the meat.

Machete.author: dayz
Machete.descriptionShort: Surprisingly sharp large machete. It is basically a big knife. Very useful for self-defense.

Pitchfork.author: dayz
Pitchfork.descriptionShort: Agricultural tool composed of a long handle and thick prongs at one end. Used to lift and pitch hay, straw or leaves. Quite capable of piercing through soft materials.

Pickaxe.author: dayz
Pickaxe.descriptionShort: As a digging tool, a pickaxe can indeed be used to dig, mine, or even defend oneself if needed.

Sword.author: dayz
Sword.descriptionShort: Faithful replica of a medieval sword. Still sharp and deadly.

KukriKnife.author: dayz
KukriKnife.descriptionShort: An exotic heavy blade. Effective on wood as on flesh.

FangeKnife.author: dayz
FangeKnife.descriptionShort: Handcrafted knife. It seems to be an heirloom of some hunter.

CrudeMachete.author: dayz
CrudeMachete.descriptionShort: A quite solid machete with a sharp blade. Although it looks like scrap metal it's a very efficient cutting tool.

OrientalMachete.author: dayz
OrientalMachete.descriptionShort: It's not clear if this fine blade has been forged to be displayed on a wall or to cut through flesh.

BaseballBat.author: dayz
BaseballBat.descriptionShort: A wooden baseball bat made for hitting baseballs. Or, if there are none around, any suitable substitute.

NailedBaseballBat.author: dayz
NailedBaseballBat.descriptionShort: An upgraded baseball bat with several nails going through. If you're not on the receiving end, it may bring you good luck.

BarbedBaseballBat.author: dayz
BarbedBaseballBat.descriptionShort: Baseball bat wrapped with barbed wire. It brings a world of hurt to poor souls on the receiving end. No exceptions.

XmasBaseballBat.author: dayz
XmasBaseballBat.descriptionShort: A baseball bat wrapped in colorful decorations. Hitting stuff has never been so lighthearted and fun.

PipeWrench.author: dayz
PipeWrench.descriptionShort: Adjustable wrench. Once used for turning nuts or bolts, now it makes a decent blunt weapon.

BrassKnuckles_Dull.author: dayz
BrassKnuckles_Dull.descriptionShort: Effective hand-to-hand weapon, easily concealed from unattentive enemies. Makes for a nasty surprise afterwards.

HockeyStick.descriptionShort: $UNT$Ice hockey stick, made of wood, used in the sport of ice hockey to navigate puck by players. Using the hockey stick as a weapon during a match is strictly forbidden.

Chainsaw.author: dayz
Chainsaw.descriptionShort: $UNT$A portable chainsaw. It is used in activities such as tree felling, limbing, bucking, pruning, by tree surgeons to fell trees and remove branches and foliage, to fell snags and assist in cutting firebreaks in wildland fire suppression, and to harvest firewood. Operate with extreme caution.

CattleProd.author: dayz
CattleProd.descriptionShort: Battery-powered tool designed for driving the cattle. Not that it couldn't be used in self-defense, mind you.

StunBaton.author: dayz
StunBaton.descriptionShort: Non-lethal melee weapon used for crowd control. Requires batteries to stun the rowdy target.
